title: Training Note: First Returned Payment Relief, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Re-opened Installment Charge
content:
**Training note, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.** A late charge on an installment that a returned payment re-opened is relieved when that return is the only one the contract has ever had.

**Rule.** When the most recent returned payment is the only returned payment ever recorded on the contract and the contract has never been extended, the charge figured at the rate is halved and the result rounded down to the whole dollar; when it is the only returned payment ever recorded on the contract and the contract has been extended at least once, the charge figured at the rate is multiplied by three quarters and the result rounded down to the whole dollar; in every other case the charge figured at the rate is kept to the cent.

The charge figured at the rate is the late charge as computed on the re-opened amount, rounded to the cent, before the late-charge cap; the cap then applies to the figure this rule produces.

## Points of judgement

| Returned payments ever recorded on the contract | Contract ever extended (installments deferred over its life above zero) | Figure carried to the cap |
|---|---|---|
| exactly one | no | half of the charge at the rate, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| exactly one | yes | three quarters of the charge at the rate, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| two or more | either | the charge at the rate, to the cent |

The count is of returned payment entries on the contract's ledger over its whole life, not a recent window.

## Q&A on the basis

**Does "rounded down to the whole dollar" mean to the nearest dollar?** No: the cents are dropped. A hypothetical charge at the rate of 23.86 dollars halves to 11.93 and becomes 11.00 dollars; three quarters of it is 17.895 and becomes 17.00 dollars.

**A contract had one returned payment three years ago and a second one this month — is the second relieved?** No: two returned payments are recorded on the contract, so the charge at the rate is kept to the cent.
